title: Sankhya Yoga
summary: Chapter 2 is a summary of the entire Bhagavad Gita. Krishna begins His instructions by explaining the immortality of the soul and the importance of performing one's duty without attachment to results.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
तं तथा कृपयाविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम् |
विषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः ||
verses.translation: Sanjaya said: Seeing Arjuna full of compassion, his mind depressed, his eyes full of tears, Madhusudana, Krishna, spoke the following words.
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca
taṃ tathā kṛpayāviṣṭam aśru-pūrṇākule-kṣaṇam
viṣīdantam idaṃ vākyam uvāca madhusūdanaḥ
verses.meaning: sañjayaḥ uvāca—Sanjaya said; tam—unto Arjuna; tathā—thus; kṛpayā—by pity; āviṣṭam—overwhelmed...

verses.sanskrit:
कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः
पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसम्मूढचेताः |
यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्चितं ब्रूहि तन्मे
शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् ||
verses.translation: Now I am confused about my duty and have lost all composure because of miserly weakness. In this condition I am asking You to tell me for certain what is best for me. Now I am Your disciple, and a soul surrendered unto You. Please instruct me.
verses.transliteration:
kārpaṇya-doṣopahata-svabhāvaḥ
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ dharma-sammūḍha-cetāḥ
yac chreyaḥ syān niścitaṃ brūhi tan me
śiṣyas te 'haṃ śādhi māṃ tvāṃ prapannam
verses.meaning: kārpaṇya—of miserliness; doṣa—by the flaw; upahata—being afflicted; sva-bhāvaḥ—characteristics...

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन |
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ||
verses.translation: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of action. Never consider yourself the cause of the results of your activities, and never be attached to not doing your duty.
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stv akarmaṇi
verses.meaning: karmaṇi—in prescribed duties; eva—certainly; adhikāraḥ—right; te—of you; mā—never...
